clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lost Fleet, Snellig's Snuffbox remains with its undead owner among the wrecks. First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor wants it as proof his cursed crewmate has been put to rest.

First Mate Snellig still clutches his snuffbox in a wreck off the northern Wetlands. When the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras ran aground there, its sailors and officers drowned beneath a mysterious power tied to a hidden treasure aboard the ships. Bound by that power, the drowned crew rose again as tortured spirits and skeletal undead. Snellig haunts the rotting hold of the wreck closest to the coastline. His snuffbox is a small, ordinary reminder of his mortal life at sea. First Mate Fitzsimmons, the disaster's sole living survivor, wants this possession returned as proof that at least one lost shipmate has found release from torment.
